'''R5-J2''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine-programmed]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[R5-series astromech droid]] stationed aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The cheap [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was present in one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived to oversee the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] construction. R5-J2's service with the Empire was short-lived, however, as the battlestation was destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
[[File:R5-J2_cropped.jpg|thumb|left|200px|R5-J2]]
R5-J2 was a cheap, [[Gender/Legends|masculine-programmed]] [[Class two droid/Legends|second-degree]] [[R5-series astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Empire commissioned the construction of a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="figure" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], construction of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] had begun over the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> R5-J2 was one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] assigned to the [[Space station/Legends|station]];<ref name="figure" /> he was present in one of the Death Star's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived to order the [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|station's commander]] to speed up construction on the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], and was also present among the other droids when [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Emperor's personal shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] arrived at the Death Star's [[Hangar 272/Legends|Hangar 272]] shortly afterward.<ref name="ROTJ" />

In 4 ABY, the Rebel Alliance gained knowledge of the second Death Star's existence. Additionally, they learned that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine was personally overseeing the superweapon's final stages of construction. Determined to destroy the Death Star and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor in one act, the Alliance launched an [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault]] on the incomplete battlestation. The Alliance ultimately proved victorious and the Death Star was obliterated,<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> abruptly ending the droid's service before he knew it.<ref name="figure" />

==Characteristics==
R5-J2 was an R5-series astromech droid that possessed masculine programming.<ref name="figure" /> He boasted a black-and-silver body, though some of his panels were painted bronze.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> R5 was cheap&mdash;his primary selling feature.<ref name="figure" /> His tool arms were his instruments of choice.<ref name="tin" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Darth_Vader_with_droids_-_SWTAFA.jpg|220px|thumb|Promotional photo of R5-J2 with [[R2-Q5/Legends|R2-Q5]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]]]
R5-J2 appeared in [[1983]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as an unidentified droid extra, barely visible in the Death Star's hangar bay at the beginning of the film. The droid would go without a proper designation until [[2006]]'s [[Star Wars: The Saga Collection|''The Saga Collection'']] line, which included an [https://www.rebelscum.com/tsc058r5j2.asp action figure] of the droid that provided the designation R5-J2.

Because part of the filmed footage of Vader's arrival on the Death Star was [[:File:MoffJerjerrodGreetsVader.jpg|reused]] for Vader's arrival aboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] following his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] at the end of the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], R5-J2 can be glimpsed in the ''Executor''{{'s}} hangar bay. However, this droid is not necessarily R5-J2.
